$comment: How pi-system is delivered. git (the primary public path): releases are tags (vX.Y.Z) and `next` is the main branch of git.source, both on public GitHub, so no credentials or npm account are needed. npm: releases are dist-tags of npm.package (published by .github/workflows/release.yml, manual and currently unused). git.legacySources lists retired private sources: an install registered from one is migrated to git.source and never reconnected to it. Per-machine overrides: PI_KIT_DELIVERY=git|npm, PI_SYSTEM_GIT_SOURCE=<pi git source> (ignored when it names a legacy source). See docs/releasing.md.
